author: Guy_B

title: Best way to see these sites!
text: We had SUCH a great time and learned so much. Our tour guide, Arnau, was amazing. He gave us Dalí’s entire biography on the train ride to Figueres and showed us the highlights at the museum, which made the entire experience so much more enjoyable and enlightening. Then, he guided us around Besalú and Girona with ease. It was the perfect balance of guided time and free time. Highly recommend ratafia and coques in Besalú and xuixo in Girona. Arnau was so knowledgeable and engaging. I’ve spent some time in Spain and feel pretty capable navigating around myself, but I feel this tour genuinely was

title: Five star experience !
text: I signed up for this experience during our family trip to Barcelona and I can say that it was the highlight of our trip! Our guide Marco was knowledgeable and very accommodating . He knew all the best places for photo ops, landmarks , and restaurants . He share an insider’s perspective that made our experience wonderful and memorable . I highly recommend this tour. I feel that we got a great deal for our money .
author: 99ximenam

title: Figuers, Besalu and Girona!
text: This was a great tour. Started with The Dali Museum in Figuers, followed by Besalu and Girona. Our tour guide, Marco, was excellent. He was very friendly and knowledgeable! The amount of travel time between cities was shorter than all the other tours, giving us more time to spend in each town. I would highly recommend this trip!
author: Tiffany_B

title: Best tour ever
text: Best experience with Marco; thank you very much for all the information. The idea of combining the 3 places is awesome. Thank you so much
